edges.reason: Any external caller (msg.sender) can invoke SetBurnAddress because it has no onlyOwner modifier.
truenews acts as a hidden owner that SetBurnAddress promotes to _owner.
SetBurnAddress overwrites the _owner state variable with truenews.
block.timestamp (now) is used as entropy in randomly(), creating timestamp dependency.
british counter combined with the timestamp seeds the pseudo-random draw.
randomly() is invoked from within _transfer on each qualifying transfer.
joker mapping is read and written inside _transfer to gate or propagate blocked state.
wonderw mapping determines whether the amount/basil and darkknight checks apply.
darkknight flag can permanently force a sender's transfer to revert.
thisValue enables the darkknight rejection path in _transfer.
basil is compared with amount and mutated, defining a manipulable transfer threshold.
_transfer updates _balances[sender] and _balances[recipient] via SafeMath sub/add.
creator is special-cased in _transfer to silently rewrite recipient flags.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as sender or recipient from the external entry points.
transfer() delegates execution to internal _transfer.
transferFrom() delegates execution to internal _transfer.
DarkTwist (onlyOwner) calls _mint to create tokens without a supply cap.
_mint increases _totalSupply through SafeMath.add.
_mint credits _balances[account] through SafeMath.add.
TimeTime lets the owner set wonderw[spender] for any address.
TimeTime lets the owner set joker[spender] for any address.
TimeTime lets the owner set darkknight[spender] for any address.
TimeTime flips thisValue, activating global transfer blocking.
UnsetInfinity (onlyOwner) resets basil to chTx and enables thisValue.
BurnDarnkess (onlyOwner) sets an arbitrary basil threshold affecting all non-whitelisted senders.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
local tok is forced to 18724 when joker[owner] is set, silently corrupting the approved allowance.
transferFrom reads and subtracts from _allowances using SafeMath.sub.
_approve reads joker[owner] to decide whether to override the allowance value.
alberta one-shot flag grants wonderw[spender] to the first spender approved by the creator.
_approve writes wonderw[spender]=true, bypassing the transfer restrictions.
_msgSender() supplies owner/spender values for _approve on approve, increase and decrease paths.
transferOwnership (onlyOwner) delegates to internal _transferOwnership.
renounceOwnership zeroes the _owner state variable.
Constructor assigns _owner to the deployer.
Constructor stores the deployer in truenews, creating an undocumented second owner.
msg.sender becomes creator, _owner and truenews during deployment.
_burn reduces _totalSupply via SafeMath.sub.
approve delegates to internal _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve after SafeMath.add on the allowance.
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the sender of the funds.
block.timestamp feeds directly into the pseudo-random unsafe operation.
SetBurnAddress performs its privileged ownership change with no caller check.
randomly() materializes the timestamp-derived randomness unsafe operation.
DarkTwist performs unlimited owner-controlled minting.
_transfer silently mutates wonderw, joker and darkknight, enabling honeypot behaviour.
TimeTime performs bulk mutation of global transfer-gating flags.
